answer_1.quote: We propose a speech normalization technique ... Experiments on four language pairs show that when trained with the normalized target speech ... the performance of a textless S2ST model can be improved ... Direct S2ST aims at translating speech in the source language to speech in the target language without the need of text generation as an intermediate step.
answer_1.outputs: target speech (spectrogram/audio) generated from source speech

answer_2.quote: To evaluate translation quality, we first use opensourced ASR models to decode all systems' speech output... we compute BLEU using SACRE-BLEU. We also compute unit error rate (UER) between unit sequences and word error rate (WER) for resynthesized audio.

answer_4.quote: We collect mean opinion scores (MOS) from human listening tests. We randomly sample 200 utterances for each system, and each sample is rated by 5 raters on a scale of 1 (the worst) to 5 (the best).
answer_4.guideline: Raters listen to each generated audio and assign a score from 1 to 5 representing naturalness/quality of the speech.
